Name: Appleseed's Lathe
Author: TheAppleSauceIsStale
Description:
[size=3]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url],[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1861] PFM Jewelcraft [/url]and more recently [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43509]Star Jewelers[/url], This mod adds the [b][color=#e69138]Lathe[/color][/b], a new machine gifted to you by Clint after you reach Mining Level 5 and sit through a sort of awkward conversation with him. With it, you'll be able to boost the value of a variety of resources. You can experiment with different precious stones (including Prismatic Shards) to create uniquely colored pieces of jewelry and faberge eggs, or with cloth and feathers to craft quills and elegant, customizable fans, or with radioactive bars to turn your hard work into an active biohazard! [/size]


[center][img]https://imgur.com/Kw14XJO.png[/img][/center]

[size=3]Clint will send you a letter the morning after reaching Mining Level 5. After reading the letter, enter town at any time to receive a Lathe and learn its crafting recipe.[/size]

[size=3][color=#ffffff]Gift tastes for Vanilla NPCs are included, as well as a few modded ones! More modded Npc compatibility and custom gift reactions may arrive later.[/color][/size]

[size=3]Depending on which items are enabled and what criteria you've reached, you'll receive up to [color=#e69138]11[/color] new Quests via mail, and be able to fulfill [color=#e69138]3[/color] new Special Orders. (Quests are spaced out with heart events and can only trigger after seeing Clint's initial Lathe event, but still be prepared for an influx of letters if you're far along in your save!)[/size]

[size=3](Sam's and Sebastian's Quests will accept items carved from bones and shells, but not items carved from horns.)[/size]


[center][color=#ff7700][img]https://imgur.com/Ex4isV3.png[/img][/color][/center]

[size=3][color=#ffffff]To minimize the amount of duplicates when playing with other mods (and for general flexibility) any category of item can be removed or re-added at any time. You can also control how certain animations play, if at all. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] is highly recommended![/color][/size]

[spoiler][color=#e69138][b]Exclude Items From Perfection (Default False)[/b][b]:[/b] [/color][color=#ffffff]Decides if all items count towards shipping collection completion (except for the Coronation Egg, which is always excluded.)[/color]

[b][color=#e69138]Quests (Default True): [/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4]Adds or removes mailed quests depending on which items are enabled.[/color]

[b][color=#e69138]Special Orders (Default True): [/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4]Adds or removes Special Orders depending on which items are enabled.[/color]

[b][color=#e69138]Item Toggles (All Default True except for Carved Horn Items): [/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Carved Stone Items: [/color][/b][color=#ffffff]Adds or removes Stone Fruit / Stone Doves / Stone Vessels / Stone Statuettes.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Carved Wood Items: [/color][/b][color=#ffffff]Adds or removes Wooden Fruit / Wooden Doves / Wooden Vessels / Wooden Statuettes.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Carved Marble Items: [/color][/b][color=#ffffff]Adds or removes Marble Fruit / Marble Doves / Marble Vessels / Marble Statuettes.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Carved Bone and Shell Items[/color][/b][color=#ffffff]: Adds or removes Dice, Drinking Horns and Combs.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Carved Horn Items: [/color][/b][color=#ffffff]Adds or removes versions of Dice, Drinking Horns and Combs that can be made from horns and antlers. Should only be enabled if you have mods installed that add animal horns or antlers like the ones listed below.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Metal and Quartz Items: [/color][/b][color=#ffffff]Adds or removes items carved from Copper Bars, Iron Bars, Iridium Bars, and foraged minerals.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Jewelry: [/color][/b][color=#ffffff]Adds or removes all Jewelry, including basic, prismatic and irradiated versions.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Watches and Compasses:[/color] [/b][color=#ffffff]Adds or removes Pocket Watches, Compasses and their irradiated versions.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Quills:[/color][/b][color=#ffffff] Adds or removes Quills.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Hand Fans:[/color][/b][color=#ffffff] Adds or removes Hand Fans.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Refurbish Ornamental Fans:[/color][/b][color=#ffffff] Enable or Disable the ability to "fix" Ornamental Fans with the Lathe.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#e69138][b]Faberge Eggs:[/b] [/color][color=#ffffff]Adds or removes all Jeweled Eggs, including Coronation Eggs and prismatic versions.[/color][/*]
[/list][b][color=#e69138]Animation Settings:[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Item Animations (Default True):[/color] [/b][color=#ffffff]Turn all animations (including prismatic item hue shift) on or off.[/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Sparkling Item Toggles (All Default True):[/color] [/b][color=#ffffff]Decide if certain items should sparkle![/color][/*]
[*][b][color=#e69138]Prismatic Item Animation (Default Sparkles):[/color] [/b][color=#ffffff]Decide if prismatic items should sparkle! Doesn't affect their hue shift.[/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][color=#ff7700][img]https://imgur.com/bkGTmCR.png[/img][/color][/center]

[size=3][color=#ffffff]In general, the Lathe will accept any items with these context tags:[/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][color=#ffffff][b]"feather_item"[/b] (Quills, Hand Fans)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#ffffff][b]"horn_item"[/b] (Carved Horn Items)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#ffffff][b]"antler_item"[/b] (Carved Horn Items)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#ffffff][b]"category_gem"[/b] (Jewelry, Jeweled Eggs)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#ffffff][b]"category_minerals"[/b] (Jewelry)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#ffffff][b]"fabric_item"[/b] (Hand Fans)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#ffffff][b]"cloth_item" [/b](Hand Fans)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][b]"large_egg_item"[/b] (Jeweled Eggs)[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][size=3][color=#ffffff]This mod also has built-in compatibility with:[/color][/size]

[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/url]  Npc gift tastes and an additional quest (dependent on Carved Horn Items being enabled) are included.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]: Npc gift tastes included.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39216]Cloths and Colors:[/url] Hand Fans can be made with Dyed Cloth.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29720?tab=posts]Baubles:[/url] Hand Fans can be made with Dyed Cloth.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul: [/url]A price/crafting recipe/quest reward patch is applied automatically if SVBO is installed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29299]Fresh Farm Produce[/url]: Items are added to appropriate Jeweler/Subterranean/Artisan/Wildflower categories.

Compatible livestock mods have their own [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4387]Article[/url]! 
(If you have your own custom livestock you'd like to make compatible with this mod, please consider using the context tags above.)[/size]
